about.metaDescription: Bogorm is a free map of Warsaw's reading life: bookshops, libraries, book clubs and literary events.
about.heroTitle: Discover places, events and people around books in Warsaw

what.title: What is Bogorm
what.text: Bogorm is a map of Warsaw's reading life. It shows bookshops, libraries, book clubs, literary events and other places where people read.
what.free: The map is free to use.

why.title: Why it exists
why.text1: We often think of reading as something very personal.
why.text2: But every city has people who read the same books, go to the same bookshops and look for similar places to read.

about.quote: Bogorm helps them find each other.

who.title: Who makes Bogorm
who.text1: I'm Liuba Kuibida, a cultural researcher and developer from Ukraine. Bogorm is my independent project.
who.text2: I came to Warsaw because of the war. {link} (article in Polish) helped me build a new life here.
who.text3: Bogorm grew out of that experience. It will keep growing together with its community.

partners.title: For partners
partners.lead: Bogorm connects readers with the places and people who shape the city's book culture.
partners.nonCommercialText: Taking part is free: I don't charge for being on the map or for promoting events.
partners.visibilityText: Your place appears on Warsaw's reading map.
partners.readersText: Your events reach people who are looking for something to read and someone to talk books with.
partners.networkText: You meet other bookshops, libraries and literary initiatives.

contact.title: Become a partner
contact.text: The map is live and building its first partner network in Warsaw. If you run a place connected to books or organise literary events, write to me.
